source_snapshot.test_set: Intel GNR CPU RAS - DDR Command/Address Parity Check and Retry
source_snapshot.procedure: Enable C/A parity; halt and verify MC/alert registers clean; arm live MCE FTrace; inject `injectCMDParity(socket=0, mc=0, ch=0)`; verify MC shadow and alertsignal; go; correlate serial and FTrace bank13/status/extlog_mem_event.

source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 3. The following BIOS settings paths are from the Intel reference platform. Locations of these settings may be different on your BIOS implementation Customer Scripts (CScripts) Enabling The following is a quick reference of the key BIOS knobs for CScripts: • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Processor Configuration > Lock Chipset = Disable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Processor Configuration > MSR Lock Control = Disable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > IIO Configuration > DFX Global Configuration > — EV DFX Features = Enable — Disable BIOS Done = [X] ELOG Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > eMCA Settings > — EMCA Error Support= Enable — EMCA Logging Support= Enable — Corrected Error eLog = Enable — Memory Error eLog = Enable — Processor Error eLog = Enable Error Reporting Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > WHEA Settings > — WHEA Support = Enable — WHEA Log Memory Error = Enable — WHEA Log Processor Error = Enable — WHEA Log PCI Error = Enable Error Injection Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > — System Errors = Enable — System Memory Poison = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Error Injection Settings > — MCA Bank Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA PCIe* Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA PCIe* Error Action Table = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > IIO Error Enabling > — IIO/PCH Global Error Support = Enable — IIO MCA Support = Disable — IIO eDPC Support = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > PCIE Error Enabling > PCIe* Corrected Error Threshold Counter = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > PCIE Error Enabling > PCIe AER Corrected Errors = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > EMCA Settings > LMCE Support = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Memory Error Enabling > Memory Corrected Error = Enable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Uncore Configuration > Uncore General Configuration > Directory Mode Enable = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > Miscellaneous Configuration > Enable DAM Pin = Enable Firmware First Model • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > EMCA Settings > — EMCA Logging Support = Enable — EMCA CMCI-SMI Morphing = EMCA gen2 CSMI — EMCA CMCI-SMI Threshold = 0 — EMCA MCA-SMI Enable = EMCA gen 2 - MSMI • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > IIO Error Enabling > OS Native AER Support = Disable Crash Log • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Crash Log Enabling > CPU CrashLog Feature = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Crash Log Enabling > PCH CrashLog Feature = Disable 4. Other OS Notes You can use grub2-mkconfig to specify "ras=cec_disable" by modifying /etc/default/grub's "GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX" with "ras=cec_disable". 【During Test】 1. DDR Transient C/A Parity Error specific BIOS setup : • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Memory Configuration > Memory DFX Configuration > — C/A Parity Enable = Enable 2. Verify that the iMC machine check status and alert signal registers are clear prior to testing. >>> halt() >>> sv.socket0.soc.memss.showsearch("mc_status_shadow") >>> sv.socket0.soc.memss.showsearch("alert") 3. OS: Open a new terminal, enable MCE Record event for Ftrace and start reading the trace live. # cd /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/ # echo 1 > events/mce/mce_record/enable # cat trace_pipe 4. CScripts: Inject the CMD parity error - use the corresponding configuration that works for your platform. >>> ei.utils.resetInjectorLockCheck() >>> ei.mem.injectCMDParity(socket=0, mc=0, ch=0) 5. Verify that the C/A parity error was logged and that the alert signal bit was set. >>> sv.socket0.soc.memss.showsearch("mc_status_shadow") >>> sv.socket0.soc.memss.mc0.ch0.mcchan.imc0_mc_status_shadow.show() >>> sv.socket0.soc.memss.showsearch("alert") >>> sv.socket0.soc.memss.mc0.ch0.mcchan.alertsignal.show() 6. Resume the system to allow all error handling flows to complete. >>> go() 7. Serial Log Output 8. OS: Check the terminal that is reading the Ftrace trace. The details to take note of are the MC bank (13) and MC status(). This aligns with what was seen in the serial log and in CScripts. Verify an ELog record was generated indicated by extlog_mem_event. # cd /sys/kernel/debug/tracing # echo 1 > events/mce/mce_record/enable # echo 1 > events/ras/enable # cat trace_pipe
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: Verify an ELog record was generated indicated by extlog_mem_event.

test_case.test_name: DDR Transient C/A Parity Error — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate that a transient DDR command/address parity fault on socket0 MC0 channel0 asserts the expected iMC status/alert path, is handled after resume and produces the matching firmware-first FTrace ELog event.
required_package: CScripts harness version/hash/license and platform CMD-parity configuration
Expected clean and asserted MC-shadow/alertsignal fields, severity and bank13 status
Expected serial retry/recovery and extlog_mem_event fields/timing
Dedicated window and OOB crash/no-retry recovery
test_case.test_command: Identify GNR/DIMM topology and approved injector configuration; preserve logs/settings; enable C/A parity and exact source matrix; capture clean MC shadow/alert baseline; arm MCE/RAS trace before injection; halt/reset injector and issue one socket0/mc0/ch0 CMD-parity event; capture asserted MC/alert fields; go once; correlate serial, bank13/status/extlog_mem_event and recovery; restore trace/BIOS/DFX state.
test_case.expected_result: Verify an ELog record was generated indicated by extlog_mem_event.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for DDR Transient C/A Parity Error. Restore parity/debug/tracing settings and verify health

Clean pre-injection MC shadow/alert dumps and armed trace
Exact injector transcript and asserted mc0/ch0 shadow/alertsignal
